globalWageCaveats: BLS/O*NET and TWC share upstream OEWS survey data. Agreement is not independent empirical confirmation.
May2025 wage percentiles are cross-sectional employee distributions, not measured salaries at zero,5,10,20years.
TWC entry is mean of lower-paid third; experienced is mean of upper-paid two-thirds. Zero data means unavailable, not zero earnings.
